summary.text: Stephen Whyte is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 63 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He was appointed to the House in November 2021 and previously worked in university administration and communications.

paragraphs.text: Stephen Whyte earned a B.A. in political science and an M.P.A. from Brigham Young University.

His career experience includes working as vice president of Rocky Mountain University of Health Professions, as vice president of university marketing and communications and a professor of communications at Utah Valley University, and as an international affairs specialist in Washington, D.C.
The Utah House Majority Caucus appointed Whyte to the state House on November 6, 2021, to fill the vacancy created by the resignation of Francis Gibson.
